SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-20-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BOLDRIDGE, SANDRA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SAN FRANCISCO COMMUNITY CENTER ARMY STREET BINGO THE SAMOAN COMMUNITY CENTER PLAINTIFF HAS THE BURDEN OF PROOF. THE PARTIES PRESENT CONFLICTING EVIDENCE ABOUT HOW PLAINTIFF'S BINGO OCCURRED AND WHETHER SHE MISSED A BINGO SOLELY BECAUSE OF MACHINE MALFUNCTION. SINCE PLAINTIFF HAS THE BURDEN OF PROOF, I MUST RESOLVE THE CONFLICT IN FAVOR OF THE DEFENDANT. THE CORRECT NAME OF DEFENDANT IS SAMOAN COMMUNITY CENTER. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
